exceptions.title: EU Phytosanitary Certificate Physical Inspection Hold
exceptions.description: Zollamt Hamburg flagged 2 of 6 TEU containers for physical sampling and original Indonesian Ministry of Agriculture endorsement verification.

exceptions.title: Rotterdam ENS Entry Summary Declaration HS-Code Review
exceptions.description: Dutch Customs automated risk engine requested commercial invoice line-item verification for HS 8528.72.10 smart displays.
exceptions.resolution_notes: Customs broker uploaded legalized EUR.1 & packing list; awaiting release stamp.

exceptions.title: Schiphol Low-Visibility Runway Slot Restriction
exceptions.description: Dense North Sea fog reduced landing capacity at AMS; Flight ST-842 held at technical stopover for revised arrival slot.
exceptions.resolution_notes: New landing slot confirmed for 23:00 UTC.

exceptions.title: Maasvlakte Automated Straddle Carrier Queue Congestion
exceptions.description: Landside truck gate turnaround times exceeded 9 hours due to crane maintenance at Rotterdam APM Terminal.

exceptions.title: Consignee Tax ID Amendment on Sea Waybill
exceptions.description: Minor typographical correction requested on electronic Sea Waybill prior to Tuas berth arrival.

exceptions.title: Outer Shrink-Wrap Scuff on Pallet #14
exceptions.description: External moisture barrier film torn during discharge; internal inverter cabinet inspected and verified intact.
exceptions.resolution_notes: Repacked and signed off clean on Proof of Delivery (POD).
